overview: A mobile-first business billing and accounting app for Indian small and medium businesses. Manage invoices with GST auto-calculation, track inventory, and monitor business performance — all from a clean, modern dashboard.
features: Dashboard with KPI cards — Today Sales, Monthly Sales, Outstanding Payments, Inventory Value
Invoice creation with auto-calculated GST (CGST+SGST), PDF download, and preview
Inventory management with product catalog, stock status alerts, and barcode scanning
Internet Identity login with guest mode and business onboarding setup
Bottom navigation, floating action button, and side drawer menu
Realistic Indian business placeholder data in INR
